content:
Inventory kit — Edit

Create inventory kits that bundle multiple items together.

Kits automatically manage component inventory when sold or produced.

Item code

Enter a code for this kit. This provides a short identifier for invoices and reports.

Item name

Enter the name or description of this kit. This identifies what the bundle contains.

Unit Name

Enter the unit of measure for this kit, such as 'Set', 'Kit', or 'Bundle'.

Bill of materials

Define the inventory items that make up this kit. Each component will be depleted when the kit is sold.

Division

Assign this kit to a division for tracking divisional sales and inventory.

Autofill — Line description

Check this box to set a default description that appears on sales documents when this kit is selected.

DefaultLineDescription

Enter the default description to use on invoices and quotes. This can be overridden on individual transactions.

Autofill — Unit price

Check this box to set a default selling price for this kit.

DefaultSalesUnitPrice

Enter the default selling price. This will automatically populate when the kit is selected on sales transactions.

Autofill — Sales — Division

Check this box to assign sales of this kit to a specific division by default.

DefaultDivision

Select the default division for sales transactions. This can be changed on individual transactions.

Autofill — Tax Code

Check this box to apply a default tax code when this kit is sold.

DefaultTaxCode

Select the default tax code for this kit. This determines the tax rate on sales.

Custom income account

Check this box to use a custom income account instead of the default inventory sales account.

IncomeAccount

Select the income account where sales of this kit should be recorded.

Hide item name on printed documents

Check this box to show only the item code on printed documents, hiding the item name.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this kit. Inactive kits won't appear in selection lists but retain their history.
